issues.desc: CHK-003 is scoped as internal smoke/validation work rather than a user-observable acceptance outcome. Keep the coverage, but make the product-facing outcome explicit: users can run lifecycle_check in text/json and see stable readiness rows, exact next actions, and evidence that the command performs no mutations.
